title: Fahhh
blurb: One syllable, no spelling anybody agrees on, and yet everyone knows precisely what it means. The fahhh scream is shock, panic and flat disbelief compressed into a strangled half-second — the noise a person makes when a situation overtakes their vocabulary. It spread through TikTok and Discord as reaction audio for anything that goes wrong at speed: a slip, a crash, a message landing in visibly the wrong chat. This is the standard-volume edition, mixed for people who would quite like their friends to retain their hearing. A louder version exists, should you have decided otherwise.
